newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade active at $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade active at $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade turned active in the Panhandle area by mid day Wednesday, USDA reported.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady with last test. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 38,000 slaughter steers and 23,600 heifers; 116,300 head confirmed for week to date which includes 31,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1025 lbs 63.50.
Wk to date: 116,300 Last Week: 87,000 Year Ago: 61,900
